messages.en:
{07 00 00}My goal for the day is to 
collect a complete
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!
{ff 00 00 06}Blathers {ff 00 00 00}told me that its
skeleton is so big, it
comes as multiple fossils!
{07 14 00}So I don't care which piece
I get, as long as it's from
the {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 0d 00}See, I'm not picky! I'll take
whatever help I can get,
{04 02 00}!
